lines.en: This has a 15-inch screen, dual-hemi processor,
and it's got the quadri-port speed drive,
which is, like, ultra-state-of-the-art.
I want a blue one.
Well, don't you want to know about the speed
and how much memory it has and--
I want a blue one.
Well, we'll get you a blue one.
So, how do I email this to my doctor?
You know, those are your system preferences.
Why would you email a doctor your system preferences?
Sorry! Robbie is screaming at me!
I'm hungry!
Turn off the heat!
No!
Why does he do that to me?
I stayed up all night working on it.
- You guys won't believe what-- - You fixed the phaser?
Oh, I fixed the phaser.
Whoa!
- How did-- what did she-- - I don't know!
And this button lets you choose between 14 different channels.
That's a lot of channels.
Right!
And then this is the volume control.
This button makes it louder.
And I bet that makes it less louder.
Yes!
And then you just press this button to talk
and release it to listen.
Dang, that's neat.
Real neat.
Wow!
